protection.name: Lentil Vascular Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lentis)
protection.geography: All Indian Belts (Heavy in MP, UP, Rajasthan, Bihar)
protection.impact: Soil-borne vascular infection; occurs at two stages: (1) Seedling stage: seedlings collapse and dry up; (2) Reproductive stage (pod-fill): leaves turn pale yellow, droop, and roll inward; upper foliage wilts suddenly; vascular xylem turns brown/black inside the taproot; field mortality can reach 30–70%.
protection.passage: Lentil — source table 134, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Lentil Rust (Uromyces viciae-fabae)
protection.geography: Cool, Damp Gangetic & Terai Belts (Severe in Eastern UP, Bihar, WB)
protection.impact: Small, circular-to-oval, yellowish-brown powdery pustules (uredinia) on leaves, stems, and pods; pustules darken to blackish-brown telia late in the season; leaves dry up, curl, and shed prematurely (severe defoliation); pods fail to form or produce shriveled seeds; causes 30–80% crop destruction.
protection.passage: Lentil — source table 134, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Black Bean Aphid / Pea Aphid (Aphis craccivora, Acyrthosiphon pisum)
protection.geography: All Commercial Belts (Dry warm spells in late winter)
protection.impact: Dense colonies of shiny black or dark-green aphids cluster on tender shoots, flowering peduncles, and young pods; suck phloem sap, causing leaf curling, flower drying, and stunted pod development; exude sticky honeydew that fosters black sooty mold.
protection.passage: Lentil — source table 134, row 4. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Ascochyta Blight (Ascochyta lentis)
protection.impact: Circular-to-irregular light-brown spots with dark margins and tiny black specks (pycnidia) on leaves and pods; stems develop sunken brown girdling lesions, causing branches to snap; infected pods produce stained, shriveled seeds.
protection.passage: Lentil — source table 134, row 5. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Collar Rot & Damping-Off (Sclerotium rolfsii, Rhizoctonia solani)
protection.impact: Dark, water-soaked, rotting lesions at the soil line on young stems; white fan-like fungal mycelium with tiny brown mustard-seed-like sclerotia coats the stem collar; seedlings topple over and rot under excess moisture.
protection.passage: Lentil — source table 134, row 6. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Pulse Beetle / Bruchid (Callosobruchus chinensis)
protection.impact: Adult beetles lay white eggs on dried seed coats; grubs burrow inside cotyledons, hollowing out seeds and leaving round exit holes; destroys seed germination, test weight, and dal milling yield.
protection.passage: Lentil — source table 134, row 7. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.
